description: Adds and takes out tester Google Groups (by their email address, like testers@googlegroups.com) on one internal or closed testing track, straight to Google Play in one edit (needs a token allowed to submit). Everyone in an added group can then join through the opt-in link and get the track's build, so from an agent it waits for a person's approval. Single email addresses can't be added: Play's API takes only Google Groups; email lists are managed in Play Console. Open testing has no list. Play allows each app only so many edits a day: change several groups in one call rather than one call each.

add.description: Google Groups to add, by email address.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

track.description: The testing track, like internal or alpha (ploa_play_testers_get lists them).

name: ploa_play_testers_save
title: Change Google Play testers
